content_calendar.phase: Launch · 31 Jul – 2 Aug — Payday + Teemill FREEPOST weekend

content.title: Launch — Fri 31 Jul, 12:07
content.content: Brother to Brother, redesigned. An interpretation of the 1991 classic — new writings by Black gay men — now worn small, over the heart. Organic cotton, printed to order. It's payday — and the post is free: free UK delivery on everything, this weekend only, ends Sunday midnight. blkoutuk.com/shop

content.title: The tee — Sat 1 Aug
content.content: Payday weekend, brothers. Free UK delivery on everything until Sunday midnight — Teemill's freepost weekend. The white tee with the black badge, worn over the heart — the 1991 pairing. blkoutuk.com/shop

content.title: Last day — Sun 2 Aug
content.content: Last day — free UK delivery ends midnight tonight. Take the space. Bring a brother. The Brother to Brother monogram, worn over the heart: blkoutuk.com/shop
